name: Configure an OAuth application
description: Fill in an application name, callback URL and region, enable telemetry, then save and confirm the success message. Values are supplied by you when the workflow starts.
objective: Walk me through configuring this application

steps.title: Enter App Name
steps.instruction: Click the 'App Name' field and type the exact value shown.
steps.expected_result: 'App Name' contains the value you supplied.
steps.why: The form cannot be saved without a name.

steps.title: Enter Callback URL
steps.instruction: Click the 'Callback URL' field and type the exact value shown.
steps.expected_result: 'Callback URL' contains the value you supplied.
steps.why: The provider rejects a callback that does not start with https://.

steps.title: Choose Region
steps.instruction: Open the 'Region' dropdown and choose the region you need.

steps.title: Review Enable telemetry
steps.instruction: Set the 'Enable telemetry' checkbox according to your policy, then confirm.
steps.expected_result: 'Enable telemetry' is set as you intended.
steps.why: This decides whether usage data leaves your machine.

steps.title: Click Save Configuration
steps.why: Nothing is stored until the form is submitted.
